files.role: Single home of the oral pass rule and of every oral-state transition (section and essay), including the unguided-essay failure cascade. No HTTP, no request parsing. Caller owns the transaction.

public_objects.name: SCORE_MAX
public_objects.purpose: 6 - upper bound of the examiner score scale.

public_objects.name: PASS_THRESHOLD_PERCENT
public_objects.purpose: 70 - the single pass threshold for all four oral kinds.

methods.name: score_percent
methods.purpose: score / SCORE_MAX * 100 rounded to one decimal, for response echo only (never used for the verdict).

methods.name: apply_section_attempt
methods.purpose: Upsert section_oral_state per internal_flow step 6; returns effects (e.g. section_guided_unlocked, section_unguided_passed). A failing attempt only updates the *_latest_score; guided pass is sticky; a failing unguided section attempt never clears unguided_passed.

methods.name: apply_essay_attempt
methods.purpose: Upsert essay_oral_state; on a failing unguided attempt made while unguided_passed was true, run the FAILURE CASCADE (essay + all section unguided invalidation via server now(), then revalidation.flag_essay_cards_for_revalidation) and return effect essay_unguided_failed_cascade with cards_flagged. Reads prior state via insert-if-absent then SELECT ... FOR UPDATE so concurrent failing imports cascade once.

files.role: Revalidation primitives: grade-to-outcome rule, flagging, flag clearing, audit event. Imported by oral_state.py and routers/flashcards.py; imports neither.

public_objects.name: REVALIDATION_FAIL_GRADES
public_objects.purpose: ('again',) - grades treated as an incorrect revalidation answer; every other valid grade is correct.

methods.name: is_revalidation_correct
methods.purpose: True iff grade not in REVALIDATION_FAIL_GRADES.

methods.name: flag_essay_cards_for_revalidation
methods.purpose: UPDATE flashcard_review_state SET needs_revalidation = true for every card of the essay with last_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL; touches no other column; returns the number flagged.

methods.name: clear_revalidation_flag
methods.purpose: Set needs_revalidation = false for one card. For the failed path this must happen in the same transaction as the FSRS UPDATE.

methods.name: record_revalidation_event
methods.purpose: Append one revalidation_events row (outcome 'preserved' | 'failed'); checked_at defaults to server now().

files.role: Single definition of Established/Learned thresholds and of all derived progress SQL (section state, essay state, card state, unlock predicate). Pure SQL-fragment builders; no DB access of its own.

public_objects.name: UNLOCKED_SECTION_SQL
public_objects.purpose: Predicate fragment, expects flashcards aliased f: EXISTS (select 1 from essaycards.section_oral_state sos where sos.section_id = f.section_id and sos.guided_passed).

public_objects.name: CARD_STATE_SQL
public_objects.purpose: CASE expression yielding locked/new/learning/established/learned; expects aliases f and frs.

methods.name: section_progress_sql
methods.purpose: Per-section SELECT (aliases essay e, section s) producing the GET /progress/sections columns; SECTION STATE and next_step logic live only here.

methods.name: essay_progress_lateral_sql
methods.purpose: LEFT JOIN LATERAL fragment (enclosing alias e) exposing essay_state, essay_next_step and the supporting essay_* / count columns; reuses the section state expression for 'every section unguided'. ESSAY STATE logic lives only here.
